Telangana CM Alleges BJP Plotting Delimitation for Seat Increase

Telangana Chief Minister Revanth Reddy has accused the Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) of planning a delimitation exercise. Reddy claims this delimitation aims to increase the number of seats in the state assembly and potentially in Parliament. He asserted that despite any such move, the Congress party would still emerge victorious.
